/legal-pages/privacy-policy.description: We design and build high performing websites and digital products using no code and AI powered workflows, helping teams move fast from idea to launch.
p: MVN Studio (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
When you visit our website or contact us, we may collect personal information you provide voluntarily, such as your name, email address, and any details submitted through forms or messages.

We also automatically collect basic usage data, including IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, and time spent on the site. Cookies and similar technologies help us improve your experience and analyze site performance. We use this information to respond to inquiries, provide support, optimize the website, and, with your permission, send occasional updates or promotional content.
We do not sell or rent your personal information. However, we may share data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating the website, such as hosting providers or email platforms.

We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect our legal rights. You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, request corrections, opt out of marketing emails, and request deletion of your data where legally applicable.
To make any request, contact us at hello@mvnstudio.com
We take reasonable measures to secure your information, but no online system is completely risk-free.

By using this site, you accept the inherent risks of internet communication. Our website may contain links to external sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external websites. We may update this policy periodically, so please check this page for the latest version.
